title: A mathematical model for colloids deposition in porous media combined with a moving boundary at the microscale: Solvability and numerical simulation
summary: We study a reaction-diffusion model posed on two distinct spatial scales that accounts for diffusion, aggregation, fragmentation, and deposition of populations of colloidal particles within a porous material. In this model, the macroscopic transport of the particles is described by an effective equation whose transport coefficients are determined by cell problems posed on the underlying pore scale.
